Name: Anywhere MiniObelisk
Author: slpOff
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=5]Place and use Mini-Obelisks anywhere!
[/size][/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Mini-Obelisks are no longer limited to just two placements. You can place multiple Mini-Obelisks freely. [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Each Mini-Obelisk can have its own color setting. Obelisks with the same color will warp sequentially between each other. [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Mini-Obelisks also work outside the farm, allowing travel between different maps. Humanity finally invented public transportation using glowing rocks. Remarkable species.[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Multiplayer support is currently in beta and still being tested. Feedback from players who can test multiplayer is greatly appreciated![/font][/*]
[/list]
